title_zh: 港口的世界：全球贸易的海上网络
title_en: China's Ports (20/20): A World of Ports, the Sea Network of Global Trade
note_en: Repeating 一 plus a measure word, as in 一座座港口就像一个个节点 "port after port is like a node," stresses a long series of individual things, much like English "one after another" or "port after port." The pattern is 一 + measure word + measure word + noun (一座座, 一个个, 一条条), and it works with whatever measure word the noun normally takes.
